entities.title: Relevance is its own field
entities.question: How should the registry store 1.2/1.0/0.7 when the library mixes it with P0/P1 priority?
options: Separate 'relevance' (categorical) from priority and evidence depth
assumptions: Library README states the intended semantics
entities.decision: Store relevance only as categorical 1.2/1.0/0.7/null; do not import P0/P1 as relevance; keep study_depth and reliability separate.
unknowns: Intended scale for each of the 57 mixed records
revisit_when: Library authors publish a normalised field
